rubric.GO: Reproducible interpretable nonopening normalized differences, relative to within-group dispersion, broadly robust to top1/median and both block lengths. Exploratory only.
rubric.NO_GO: Almost indistinguishable nonopening profiles under robust comparisons in this SPY proxy/date span; not an equivalence proof.
rubric.WEAK: Minor/uncertain or mechanically dominated opening contrast, fragile or discordant evidence; no numerical threshold selected from results.

evaluation: P0 descriptive only, no fitted models or held-out claims. Full C 60/20/20 split not executed; 2022-2026 excluded.
